Three harnesses.

A portable, deterministic operating layer for coding agents — routed capabilities, sealed cross-harness dispatch, durable artifacts, and persistent memory. Write the contract once; run it everywhere.

Why a harness layer?

Vendor CLIs change fast and disagree on everything. The harness keeps one portable semantic core — core → capabilities/roles → adapters — and projects it into each runtime's native surface.

26 capabilities

Routed capabilities

12 entry routers behind one routing contract: every material task gets an explicit route card, sealed intensity, and a completion report.

sealed dispatch

Cross-harness orchestration

Standard+ work compiles an immutable route and dispatches registered headless workers across model families — plans, reviews, and tests land as files, watched live on the Fleet dashboard.

deterministic-first

Guards, not vibes

Write scopes, spec-read gates, artifact ordering, and route participation are enforced by hooks and scripts. The model judges; the code enforces.

unified memory

Memory that survives sessions

One SQLite store with tiered records, capsule-index recall on every prompt, and automatic session distillation — no manual "remember this".

spec-first

Blueprint-governed pipelines

Research → spec → code → experiment, with PRD updates versioned and drift surfaced instead of silently absorbed.

28 portable units

Roles as a catalog

Planner, reviewer, implementer, and material personas are portable units — every worker runs a sealed role, model profile, and write scope.

Architecture

Portable meaning lives in one place; each adapter is a thin projection. Nothing is hand-copied between runtimes.

Core contracts

  • core/CORE.md
  • core/WORKFLOW.md · routing
  • core/CONVENTIONS.md · QA/roles
  • core/OPERATIONS.md · dispatch
  • core/MEMORY.md

Portable catalog

  • 26 capabilities (12 entry routers)

Pick a profile

Activate only what you need. Profiles are manifest-computed; switching later is one command.

starter

6 capabilities

Everyday essentials: code entrypoint, analysis, memory, and reports.

harness install claude --profile starter

builder

13 capabilities

Analyze, specify, implement, verify, and ship software with project memory.

harness install claude --profile builder

full

26 capabilities

Everything — research writing, design pipeline, experiments, and operations.

harness install claude --profile full

Quickstart

  1. Install the verified release:
    curl -fsSL https://github.com/dmlguq456/agent_setting/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
  2. Activate a profile for your runtime(s):
    harness install claude --profile builder — repeat with codex / opencode, then harness verify.
  3. Open your agent CLI and start a routed task:
    /autopilot-code --mode dev add a health endpoint — the harness proposes the route card and closes the loop.
